guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 官方兩座門體各寬210 m、高22 m。
官方球接頭直徑10 m，課堂不據此推定容許反力。
教學600 t壓載使固定水線面平均吃水增加0.4878 m。
教學8 MN力乘60 m力臂為480 MN·m。
教學共同原因模型失效機率為0.005398。
教學資料延遲4 min乘水位速率0.12 m/min為0.48 m。
factsEn: The two official gate structures are each 210 m wide and 22 m high.
Official spherical-joint diameter is 10 m, without inferring allowable reactions.
Teaching ballast of 600 t increases mean draft by 0.4878 m at fixed waterplane area.
Teaching force 8 MN times lever arm 60 m gives 480 MN·m.
The teaching common-cause model gives failure probability 0.005398.
Teaching latency 4 min times rise rate 0.12 m/min gives 0.48 m.
timeline: 1991　馬仕朗防潮閘開始建設，保留主要航道平時開放。
1997　馬仕朗防潮閘建設完成，成為歐洲港防線的一部分。
2007　官方記載馬仕朗防潮閘首次因風暴而關閉防護。
timelineEn: 1991 — Construction begins on the Maeslant Barrier while preserving an open main navigation route.
1997 — The Maeslant Barrier is completed as part of the Europoort defence system.
2007 — The owner records the first storm-protection closure of the Maeslant Barrier.
codes: 美國陸軍工兵團工程手冊：水工鋼結構設計，EM 1110-2-2107
美國陸軍工兵團土木工程機電設計手冊，EM 1110-2-2610，2025
codesEn: USACE Design of Hydraulic Steel Structures, EM 1110-2-2107
USACE Mechanical and Electrical Design for Civil Works Structures, EM 1110-2-2610, 2025
landmarks: 馬仕朗防潮閘：球鉸支臂案例
東斯海爾德防潮閘：垂直閘門比較
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Maeslant storm-surge barrier
guides.concept: 本課以荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘為入口，深入浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Using Maeslant storm-surge barrier as its entry point, this course examines joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
procedure: 中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。水線面積決定增加重量所造成的吃水變化，不能用門高直接換算沉降。 假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。
球接頭容許多方向轉動，卻仍需把巨大門體荷載傳入陸側基礎。支臂幾何控制力矩和軸力分配，轉動自由不代表沒有反力。 假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。
細長支臂桿件可能先失穩再達材料降伏，端部拘束決定有效長度。理想歐拉式只說明幾何敏感性，實際彎曲與殘餘應力需另外處理。 假設E=200 GPa、I=0.08 m⁴、鉸支長40 m，Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN；理想直桿彈性屈曲，未含缺陷或設計折減。 節點腐蝕或鬆動會改變端部拘束，讓先前的有效長度假設失效。若只檢查材料強度，便可能漏掉受壓桿件突然出現的側向失穩。
曲面水壓應按法向分布積分，水平分量可由垂直投影求得，垂直分量則與上覆假想水體有關。曲面面積不能直接乘最大壓力。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設垂直投影寬20 m、水深5 m、單側靜水密度1025 kg/m³；水平分量ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN，未求曲面垂直分量。 把水壓視為全水平會漏掉浮沉方向荷載，影響壓載與接觸判斷。波浪使壓力隨時間和位置改變，靜水分量不能代表瞬間最大合力。
未滿的壓載艙在傾斜時移動液體重心，降低初始復原能力。相同水量分裝在窄艙或集中於寬艙，穩定效果可以不同。 假設艙液密度1000 kg/m³、自由液面慣性矩8000 m⁴、總排水質量20 million kg，虛擬重心升高ρI/m=0.4 m，限小傾角。 部分充水的過渡階段可能比空艙或滿艙更不利。若把隔板當成密閉分艙而實際有大開孔，計算會低估液體轉移和動態晃蕩。

閘門接近底床時，剩餘狹縫承受水位差並形成高速流。縮小間隙可能降低總流量卻提高局部梯度，對沉積物與門體振動產生不同作用。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設狹縫寬30 m、高0.2 m、壓差水頭1 m、Cd=0.65；Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=17.27 m³/s，僅為穩定孔口近似。 底床殘留砂石會使間隙不均，形成集中噴流與不對稱支承。若把單一水位差當作整條狹縫的條件，可能漏判局部氣蝕或振動區域。

止水縫的漏流同時受縫寬、壓差和變形控制，漏水量增大不一定是橡膠老化。以同水頭比較流量，可先排除水位改變造成的表面趨勢。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設長10 m、縫寬2 mm、Cd=0.6、Δh=3 m；Q=0.6×0.02√(2×9.81×3)=0.09206 m³/s，均勻縫且無黏性修正。 小縫中的黏性流可能不遵守孔口平方根關係，不能把正規化曲線偏移全歸於磨耗。雜物卡縫與門體歪斜也會產生相似漏水訊號。
兩套備援設備若共用電源、機房或感測來源，就不是完全獨立。風暴可能同時破壞多條功能鏈，可靠度計算必須把共同原因與單機失效分開。 假設兩單元各獨立失效機率0.02，共同原因機率0.005；簡化總失效q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398，非本站實測可靠度。 將共用電纜路徑的兩套系統視為獨立會大幅低估失效。備援設備即使定期空載測試合格，也未必能在淹水、斷電和高荷載同時出現時接替。
自動判斷取決於資料的新鮮度、時鐘與品質旗標，畫面顯示合理水位仍可能是舊值。將取樣延遲和運算時間分開，才能定位錯誤。 假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。多站同時延遲不能被誤當成一致的高品質證據。

大型活動結構除風暴荷載外也承受測試與維修循環。疲勞累積依應力範圍分組，小幅循環數量多也可能有影響，但線性損傷和忽略序列只是近似。 假設兩組循環n1=2000、N1=100000與n2=300、N2=10000，Miner和D=0.02+0.03=0.05；N值為假設，不作剩餘年限預測。 小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。若只記錄關閘次數而未量應力範圍，也無法建立可靠疲勞譜。
procedureEn: A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy. Waterplane area controls the draft change caused by added mass, rather than the overall gate height. Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition.

A spherical joint permits rotation in several directions while transmitting gate loads into shore foundations. Arm geometry controls moment and axial-force distribution; rotational freedom does not eliminate reaction forces. Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint. Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage.

A slender arm member can buckle before yielding, and end restraint sets effective length. Euler theory illustrates geometric sensitivity but leaves initial curvature and residual stresses to separate assessment. Assume E=200 GPa, I=0.08 m⁴ and pinned length 40 m. Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN, for an ideal straight elastic member without imperfections or design reductions. Joint corrosion or looseness changes end restraint and invalidates an earlier effective length. Checking material strength alone can miss sudden lateral instability in an otherwise apparently adequate compression member.

Pressure acts normal to a curved surface. Its horizontal component follows the vertical projection, while its vertical component relates to an imaginary overlying water volume; surface area times maximum pressure is inappropriate. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume vertical projection width 20 m, one-sided depth 5 m and water density 1025 kg/m³. Horizontal force ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN; the curved-surface vertical component remains separate. Treating all pressure as horizontal misses vertical loading that affects ballast and contact. Waves vary pressure in time and space, so the hydrostatic component cannot represent the maximum transient resultant.

Partially filled ballast tanks move the liquid center of gravity during heel and reduce initial stability. Equal water volumes distributed among narrow tanks or one wide tank can have different effects. Assume tank-liquid density 1000 kg/m³, free-surface second moment 8000 m⁴ and displacement mass 20 million kg. Virtual center-of-gravity rise ρI/m=0.4 m, for small heel. An intermediate filling stage may be less stable than empty or full tanks. Treating perforated baffles as sealed subdivisions understates liquid transfer and dynamic sloshing across the available free surface.

As a gate approaches the sill, the remaining slot carries the head difference and forms a jet. A smaller gap may reduce discharge while increasing local gradients, affecting sediment and vibration differently. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume slot width 30 m, height 0.2 m, head difference 1 m and Cd=0.65. Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=17.27 m³/s, a steady-orifice approximation only. Debris creates uneven gaps, concentrated jets and asymmetric contact. Assigning one head difference uniformly along the slot may miss localized cavitation or vibration zones near changing sill geometry.

Seal leakage depends on gap, head and deformation, so increased flow does not necessarily indicate rubber ageing. Comparing at equal head first removes water-level changes that can imitate deterioration. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume length 10 m, gap 2 mm, Cd=0.6 and head 3 m. Q=0.6×0.02√(2×9.81×3)=0.09206 m³/s, for a uniform slot without viscous correction. Viscous flow through a very narrow gap may not follow the orifice square-root law. Debris and gate misalignment can imitate wear, so normalized curve changes do not uniquely identify material deterioration.

Redundant equipment sharing power, rooms or sensing is not fully independent. One storm may damage several functional chains, requiring common-cause events to be separated from individual equipment failures. Assume independent unit-failure probabilities 0.02 and common-cause probability 0.005. Simplified total q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398, not a measured site reliability. Treating two systems in one cable route as independent understates failure. Successful unloaded backup tests do not prove takeover during simultaneous flooding, power loss and high mechanical demand.

Automated decisions depend on data age, synchronized clocks and quality flags. A plausible displayed water level may be stale, so sampling latency must be separated from computation time to diagnose the chain. Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min. Uncompensated difference is 0.48 m, a short-term linear illustration rather than a storm-surge forecast. Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. Replacing measurement time with arrival time conceals this defect, and several equally delayed stations do not constitute independent high-quality confirmation.

Moving structures experience test and maintenance cycles as well as storms. Fatigue accumulation groups stress ranges; many smaller cycles may matter, but linear damage and sequence independence remain approximations. Assume cycle groups n1=2000, N1=100000 and n2=300, N2=10000. Miner sum D=0.02+0.03=0.05. Assumed capacities do not predict remaining calendar life. A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. Closure counts alone cannot establish a fatigue spectrum without stress ranges.
evidence: 以浮運吃水與壓載編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。
以球鉸支臂力矩編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。繪出門體、支臂和球鉸分別的自由體圖，再用應變與位移方向核對內力路徑；確認力臂量的是垂直距離而非桁架長度。
以支臂壓桿穩定編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以測量所得桿件初彎曲建立幾何模型，核對節點轉動和側向支撐位置；比較不同有效長度的敏感性，不直接把理論臨界力當容許荷載。
以曲面門水壓分解編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。分別畫水平與垂直投影，對照多點壓力計積分與結構反力；若潮水淹過門頂或兩側皆有水，須更新濕潤邊界再計算。
以自由液面穩定修正編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以艙形與液位算自由液面慣性矩，核對隔板是否真正限制橫向流動；將傾角資料對應每個充水階段，而非只看最初和最終狀態。
evidenceEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for floating draft and ballast, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Check added mass against displaced volume and record salinity-related external density changes separately.

Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for spherical-joint arm moment, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint. Check load paths with strain and displacement directions, ensuring lever arm means perpendicular distance rather than truss length.

Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for arm compression-member stability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Model measured initial curvature, joint rotation and lateral bracing locations. Compare sensitivity to effective length instead of treating the theoretical critical force as an allowable load.

Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for resolving pressure on curved gates, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Draw separate horizontal and vertical projections, comparing integrated pressure measurements with reactions. Revise wetted boundaries whenever water overtops the gate or occupies both sides.

Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for free-surface stability correction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calculate free-surface moments from tank shape and level, checking whether baffles actually restrict transverse flow. Relate heel measurements to each filling stage rather than only initial and final conditions.
pitfalls: 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。
節點腐蝕或鬆動會改變端部拘束，讓先前的有效長度假設失效。若只檢查材料強度，便可能漏掉受壓桿件突然出現的側向失穩。
部分充水的過渡階段可能比空艙或滿艙更不利。若把隔板當成密閉分艙而實際有大開孔，計算會低估液體轉移和動態晃蕩。
小縫中的黏性流可能不遵守孔口平方根關係，不能把正規化曲線偏移全歸於磨耗。雜物卡縫與門體歪斜也會產生相似漏水訊號。
重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。多站同時延遲不能被誤當成一致的高品質證據。
pitfallsEn: Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition.

Joint corrosion or looseness changes end restraint and invalidates an earlier effective length. Checking material strength alone can miss sudden lateral instability in an otherwise apparently adequate compression member.

An intermediate filling stage may be less stable than empty or full tanks. Treating perforated baffles as sealed subdivisions understates liquid transfer and dynamic sloshing across the available free surface.

Viscous flow through a very narrow gap may not follow the orifice square-root law. Debris and gate misalignment can imitate wear, so normalized curve changes do not uniquely identify material deterioration.

Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. Replacing measurement time with arrival time conceals this defect, and several equally delayed stations do not constitute independent high-quality confirmation.

related.title: 荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘
related.transfer: 可遷移「浮運吃水與壓載」與「止水縫漏流診斷」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Floating draft and ballast" and "Seal leakage diagnosis" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析；荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘則以潮汐交換、基礎保護與巨型閘門荷載的共同約束為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability; Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier centres on coupled constraints on tidal exchange, foundation protection and large gate loads, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「浮運吃水與壓載」與「開口流速與收縮」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「潮位滯後與上浮」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Floating draft and ballast” and “Opening velocity and contraction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Tidal lag and uplift", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.title: 荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘
history.text: 馬仕朗防潮閘在鹿特丹外港航道兩岸配置大型活動門體，與哈特爾防潮閘及堤防共同形成區域防線。馬仕朗防潮閘開始建設，保留主要航道平時開放。 馬仕朗防潮閘建設完成，成為歐洲港防線的一部分。 官方記載馬仕朗防潮閘首次因風暴而關閉防護。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。
history.textEn: The Maeslant Barrier places large movable gates beside the Rotterdam approach waterway and works with the Hartel Barrier and dykes as a regional defence. Construction begins on the Maeslant Barrier while preserving an open main navigation route. The Maeslant Barrier is completed as part of the Europoort defence system. The owner records the first storm-protection closure of the Maeslant Barrier. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.
